prompts.planner:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, purposeful spacing. Design name: Quiet Day Planner.
Create ONE coherent PokeTasks v2 native macOS desktop planning screen, target 1440 x 1024. Current date Thursday 1 October 2026, Australia/Perth. Any visible date must use this anchor. This is planning concept, mock issue IDs and values.
Reference images attached: Locu Today planner and resize are layout and behavior inspirations, Locu idle timer is minimal timer inspiration, existing PokeTaskBar Projects screenshot grounds the app shell and Linear aesthetic, Locu website screenshot is contextual source. Reinterpret in the existing Linear design aesthetic, never Locu's large sidebar tile menu or bottom navigation pill.
Hard constraints: Linear-like charcoal shell #17181B, inset canvas #1F2023, selected neutral #303138, primary text #F1F1F3, secondary #92949B. Restrained small periwinkle accent #5E6AD2, no gradients, glow, glass, giant cards or excessive pills. Native SF Pro / Inter typography, 14-16 px rows, clear 24-32 px heading. Compact left sidebar width220: PokeTasks, workspace Cody, search, Today selected, Focus, Tasks, Projects, Initiatives, Insights, Collection; Settings at bottom. Calm inset canvas with 12px corners, optional timeline right supporting task-first main canvas.
Hero use case is planning today's work: header Today / Thursday, 1 October 2026 and short date navigation. Main left content ~600px wide simple 3 stacked groups labelled Today (3), Soon (2), Later (1), small add icon at each heading. Flat concise issue rows using outline status circle, title and muted issue ID / project metadata. Tasks: Refine project navigation 50m; Polish floating timer 25m; Review time-block interactions 45m. Soon: Plan activity heatmap; Refine initiative hierarchy. Later: Explore document sync. Selected first task in quiet neutral row with ONE primary Start focus button at heading/selection. Planning buckets do not modify Linear urgency or workflow.
Right day timeline ~390px wide 09:00-14:00, thin hourly rules, narrow current-time line at11:10, neutral flat blocks with small accent edge, e.g.09:00-09:50 Refine project navigation and10:00-10:25 Polish floating timer. Show the one active interaction: outlined dashed drag preview 12:20-13:50 Review time-block interactions with small floating tooltip '90 min' and '12:20–13:50'; realistic cursor at resize bottom. Leave ample empty schedule space.
Near bottom edge show a detached floating timer overlay in its resting state: small horizontal opaque graphite bar about440x42, only '24:18' and 'Polish floating timer' in bar, no always-visible controls, no issue ID, no progress strip, no icon button or grips. Tiny crisp proportional pixel Lapras companion outside the right edge of the bar; does not cover tasks. Text caption outside app is unnecessary. No feature inventory, no extra dashboard stats, no giant pet hero. One screen only, no collage.
